summary: Amod Lele is a scholar of philosophy, religious studies, and Indology who earned his PhD at Harvard University under the doctoral supervision of Parimal G. Patil.

Tibetologist and historian-archaeologist Amy Heller studied at Barnard College, INALCO, and the École Pratique des Hautes Études (PhD, ~1979–1992) under Ariane Macdonald. She taught at Yale University in 1982 and was a CNRS Tibetologist around 2005.
Amy L. Mann is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. She earned her BA at Scripps College, where she studied under thesis readers and mentors Zhiru Ng and Zayn Kassam.

Amy Paris Langenberg works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and religious studies. She earned her PhD from Columbia University (~2001–2008) and served as assistant professor of religious studies at Eckerd College around 2014.

Scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies Amy Sims Miller earned her BA from Wesleyan University (1989) and MA (1995) and PhD (2004) from the University of Virginia under David Germano, alongside studies with Janice Dean Willis and several traditional teachers.
Amy Snyder Ohta is a scholar of linguistics and Japanology who studied at UCLA (1990, 1993). She held a post at the University of Washington around 1995 and taught Qian Lin.

Ana Agud is an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Salamanca (~1966–1974) and the University of Tübingen. She served as a professor in the Department De Filologia Clasica e Indoeuropeo at the University of Salamanca (~1976–2018).

Anagarika Dharmapala worked in Buddhist studies and religious studies, having studied at Sri Jayawardenepura Maha Vidyalaya and Royal College, Colombo (~1878–1883). He founded the Maha Bodhi Society in 1891.

Scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology Anagarika Govinda earned a doctorate at the University of Freiburg and studied under Tomo Geshe Rinpoche. He lectured at Patna University (~1935–1936) and served as Ācārya at Arya Maitreya Mandala (~1933–1985).
Anam Thubten Rinpoche works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under traditional teacher Tsurlo Rinpoche and has served as a teacher at the Vajrayana Foundation.

Ananda Coomaraswamy worked in Indology, history, archaeology, and philosophy, studying at University College London (~1897–1904). He held posts at the Smithsonian Institution and the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston (~1917–1947).

Scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology Ananda W. P. Guruge studied at the University of Ceylon and the University of London. He was Professor of Educational Planning at NIEPA (~1968–1972) and Dean Emeritus of Academic Affairs at University of the West (~1995–2014).

Anant Sadashiv Altekar was an Indologist and historian-archaeologist. He held posts at Banaras Hindu University (~1930–1949) and Patna University (~1949–1959), and served as Director of the Kashi Prasad Jayaswal Research Institute (~1951–1959).

Anantalal Thakur was a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He served as a professor at the Mithila Research Institute around 1969 and as Director of the Kashi Prasad Jayaswal Research Institute from 1968 to 1971.
Ananya Jahanara Kabir is a scholar of Indology who studied at the University of Cambridge (~1993–1997). She held a post at King's College London around 2013.

Indologist and religious studies scholar Andrea Acri completed his PhD at Leiden University (~2006–2011) under Arlo Griffiths and Willem van der Molen. In 2016, he was appointed maître de conférences in tantric studies at École Pratique des Hautes Études.

Andrea R. Jain is a scholar of religious studies and Indology who studied at Southern Methodist University and Rice University. She joined Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis in 2010, becoming Associate Professor of Religious Studies around 2017.
Andrea Schlosser is a scholar in Indology and Buddhist studies. She completed her Master's degree in 2008 and her PhD in 2014, both at the Free University of Berlin.

Andreas Doctor is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned his PhD at the University of Calgary under doctoral supervisor Leslie S. Kawamura, and studied under traditional teachers including Chokyi Nyima Rinpoche and Neten Chokling Rinpoche.

Andree Dominique Messent is a scholar of Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at the University of Bristol under the doctoral supervision of Paul Williams, having also studied under Rupert Gethin and Ulrich Pagel.
